title: Podcast Promotion: How People Find You Before the Algorithm Does
description: A podcast without promotion is a diary. Here are the concrete steps to cut episodes into clips, kickstart reach and win your first regular listeners.
excerpt: You've recorded ten episodes and your mum is the audience. The content isn't the problem — distribution is.
content:
## Podcasts don't get discovered on podcast apps

Spotify and Apple won't hand you reach. There's no feed pushing your show to strangers. Podcast discovery happens somewhere else: Reels, TikTok, YouTube.

So rule one — you record once, but you publish five times.

## Turn one episode into ten pieces

A one-hour episode holds at least five moments that work on their own. Find them right after recording, while you still remember where the good line landed.

- A 30–60s vertical clip with burned-in captions. Nobody finishes a clip without them.
- One quote as a static post.
- A short LinkedIn or Threads post with the episode's actual point.
- The full episode on YouTube — search traffic keeps working for months.

## The first 48 hours decide everything

A clip that doesn't move in two days never will. That's why a new episode deserves a push on day one. A panel like **[KupSledujici.cz](https://kupsledujici.cz)** feeds early views and likes so the algorithm has data to read.

You're not buying listeners. You're buying a fair test on a wider audience.

## Metrics that matter

Track how many people click through from the clip to the episode, and how many make it past minute ten. Everything else is vanity.

## Wrap-up

Record, cut, publish, boost, measure. [KupSledujici.cz](https://kupsledujici.cz) handles the first mile. Want your episodes in other languages? Dub them with [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io). Need to convert audio or shrink a file? [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) does it free.
